full_judgment: 8. Applicants Mr. Shahabuddin Ahmed and Ms. Yeasmin Alam purchased the land covered by S.A. Khatian No. 76, S.A Plot Nos. 658 ,659, 660, 661 and 662 of Mouza-Dapa Indrakpur, Fatudlah on 2.10.2010. Those applicants also acquired the shares of Kamal Vegetables Oil Mills. The applicants got their names mutated in Mutation Khatian No. 1897 in respect of land measuring 2.35 acres of which .09 acre is occupied by a graveyard. The applicants have been enjoying the land by establishing vegetable oil refining factory. The Roads and Highways Department tried to demolish the structures of the applicants but could not succeed because of a direction made by this Court in Writ Petition No. 3120 of 2007. Applicant No. 1 also obtained licence for 494 square meter of land from BIWTA on the basis of lease for one year. The lease has since been renewed from year-to-year. The joint survey was conducted beyond the knowledge of the applicants who purchased the land and established oil refining industry investing about Tk.100 crore.
